projects.title: Who’s problem is it?
projects.description:
The British government supported the Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Kosovo for a campaign against violence, and the Ministry of Justice asked us to contribute to the creation of an awareness campaign.

Understanding the importance of such an initiative, we worked diligently to ensure that the message was communicated effectively and had an impact.
